answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Each attempt carries a waiting period of 21 days that no payment can shorten, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Every entry must show Notarised perfumer stone licence before the ledger opens, because a licence perfumers carry after scent inspections. One willow, one entry. The jetty is on the docket. The quill is checked, not assumed.
